output.reason: A 52-year-old reporting hot flashes, night sweats and irregular periods requests discussion of treatment options, which requires clinician assessment of history, risks and possible prescribing, but nothing reported is time-sensitive.
output.patientMessage: A Counsel clinician can review this in the thread and discuss your options — lifestyle steps, non-hormonal medicines, or hormone therapy — since choosing depends on your medical history and preferences. Meanwhile, layered clothing, a cool bedroom, and limiting alcohol, caffeine and spicy foods may ease hot flashes. Seek prompt care sooner if you develop heavy or unusual vaginal bleeding, or new chest pain, leg swelling or one-sided weakness.
differential: Other cause of irregular bleeding or vasomotor symptoms (e.g., thyroid disease) if symptoms persist
